capabilities: create epics, histories and incidences as Markdown notes with frontmatter
organize notes automatically into slugified folders
assign sprints, collaborators and labels to epics and histories
view progress in Kanban and Roadmap boards
customize sprint labels, states and options in settings
extras: Interface and documentation are in Spanish. Desktop only (Windows, macOS, Linux), no mobile support. Links to detailed guides elsewhere ('Anatomía del Producto'). Accepts donations via Buy Me a Coffee.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in structure for managing product epics, user stories, sprints and backlog items as linked notes.
summary: Agile epic-management plugin that keeps epics, stories, sprints, tasks and roadmap as plain Markdown notes in the vault.
